title: Radix-4 Quaternary QFT Butterfly Stage-Depth Halving and Truncation Dominance
claims: Factoring QFT_{4^k}^dagger into k radix-4 quaternary digit pairs is unitarily identical to the 2k-stage radix-2 QFT_{2^{2k}}^dagger while halving the number of outer Cooley-Tukey stages from 2k to k.

Band-1 radix-4 truncation (local 2-qubit QFT_4^dagger blocks on disjoint pairs, zero inter-pair gates) achieves 100% peak survival on 4-adic multiples and strictly dominates radix-2 band-1 (H^{otimes 2k}) truncation.
